tool_description: Search deterministic MES incident history and return matching incidents newest first. Filters may restrict time, production line, station, or error type.
server_instruction: Use list_prior_incidents to search or review previously recorded incidents. date_from, date_to, line_ids, station_ids, and error_ids are optional filters. Omitted filters mean no restriction for that dimension, so do not require clarification merely because a filter was omitted. A calendar-day request means the complete day from 00:00:00 to the following midnight.

field_descriptions.date_from: Optional inclusive timezone-naive ISO-8601 lower bound for incident occurrence time.
field_descriptions.date_to: Optional timezone-naive ISO-8601 upper bound for incident occurrence time.
field_descriptions.line_ids: Optional production line filter using line IDs 1 through 4.
field_descriptions.station_ids: Optional station filter using Station 1, Station 2, or Station 3.
field_descriptions.error_ids: Optional filter containing one or more known MES error IDs.
